_comment: Committed reference fixture for Task 6. Lists the KeeperHub actionType identifiers this bridge's workflow JSON is allowed to use. workflow.test.ts asserts every actionType referenced by keeperhub-workflow.*.json appears here, so an actionType that doesn't exist on KeeperHub (typo or renamed) fails locally instead of at workflow-creation time in Task 7. Not a copy of KeeperHub's full API schema (that call is out of scope for this task) — just the allow-list this bridge depends on.
